name: SPE Ω — G6-H blind evaluator
install:
chmod +x tools/g6h_serve.sh tools/g6h_serve_status.sh 2>/dev/null || true
python3 -c "import http.server; print('http.server-ok')"
if [ -f evaluations/g6zc/blind_evaluator.html ] && [ -f evaluations/g6zc/blind_pairs.json ]; then
  echo g6h-evaluator-ready
else
  echo 'WARN: g6h evaluator not on this git ref yet — merge evaluator/custody branches'
fi
start:
chmod +x tools/g6h_serve.sh tools/g6h_serve_status.sh 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f evaluations/g6zc/blind_evaluator.html ]; then
  echo "G6-H OPEN http://127.0.0.1:8765/evaluations/g6zc/blind_evaluator.html"
  exec python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 0.0.0.0
else
  echo 'WARN: evaluator missing on this ref'; sleep infinity
fi
